name: Umbratic Tome
skillFull: Umbratic Tome Jellies are created at certain intervals. Collecting them grants Umbral Energy. Upon gathering 3 stacks of Umbral Energy, the tome unleashes a defensive burst of dark energy to destroy all nearby obstacles. Level Up for more Dark Burst Points.
